title: On the Factors in Quantum Software Quality
abstract: arXiv:2609.29705v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As quantum computing evolves, the demand for high-quality quantum software is increasing. Classical software quality models, such as McCall's model, provide a useful foundation, but they do not explicitly capture distinctive properties of quantum software, including probabilistic measurement outcomes, backend-dependent behavior, and hybrid quantum-classical workflows. This paper proposes a base quality model for quantum software using McCall's factor-criterion-metric structure as the organizing backbone. It broadens the set of quality factors by drawing on representative classical software quality models and standards and introduces quantum-specific extensions only where needed. translated_title: 论量子软件质量的影响因素
translated_abstract: 随着量子计算的发展，对高质量量子软件的需求日益增长。经典软件质量模型（如McCall模型）提供了有用的基础，但它们并未明确刻画量子软件的独特属性，包括概率性测量结果、依赖后端的行为以及量子-经典混合工作流。本文以McCall的“因素-准则-度量”结构作为组织骨架，提出了一个量子软件的基础质量模型。该模型借鉴代表性的经典软件质量模型和标准来扩展质量因素集合，并仅在必要之处引入量子特有的扩展。我们定义了由此得到的因素集合和质量准则，提供了核心因素与准则之间关系的多对多映射，并讨论了代表性的候选度量指标及其使用时所需的执行条件、参考条件和解释条件。
tldr: 本文以McCall经典“因素-准则-度量”框架为基础，提出了一个量子软件基础质量模型，在经典质量因素之上引入了量子特有属性（如概率性测量结果、后端依赖行为和量子-经典混合工作流）的扩展。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a base quality model for quantum software built upon McCall's factor-criterion-metric structure, extending classical quality factors with quantum-specific properties such as probabilistic measurement outcomes, backend-dependent behavior, and hybrid quantum-classical workflows.
